findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: There was no certified food protection manager present during today’s inspection. PIC informed inspector that the only person who has a certified food protection manager certification went to the store. Ensure that there is at least one certified food protection manager present at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Upon arrival, inspector observed a large cutting board covering the handwashing sink restricting access. Education was carried out. The cutting board was removed. Ensure the the hand sink is always accessible and use for the sole purpose of handwashing only at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There was no sanitizer available at the beginning of today’s inspection why food was being made in the kitchen. Education was carried out. A new sani bucket was made. The sanitizer tested at 100 ppm for chlorine. Ensure that there is always sanitizer in the sani bucket at all times.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(E) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (E) If a chemical SANITIZER other than chlorine, iodine, or a quaternary ammonium compound is used, it shall be applied in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions.
